paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, estimated at near-DFSZ sensitivity)
notes: CAPP-MAX cavity haloscope search for axion dark matter over 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 ueV). Constrains axion-photon coupling at ~90% CL assuming 100% local DM at 0.45 GeV/cm3. Paper reports reaching at or near DFSZ sensitivity over the range but provides NO explicit numerical table of the limit; exclusion is shown only in Fig. 22 (not extractable numerically). The data_points are approximate estimates placed at the near-DFSZ level (g_agamma ~ 6-8e-16 GeV^-1 for m_a ~ 4.2-4.9 ueV), and should be treated as rough. The paper expresses limits in terms of g_gamma (model-dependent coefficient, DFSZ=0.36) but the exclusion plot is on axion-photon coupling.
